'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[Gaza Strip famine]]
****The [[United Nations|UN]]-backed [[Integrated Food Security Phase Classification]] officially declares a [[famine]] in [[Gaza Governorate]] in the [[Gaza Strip]], while conditions in the [[North Gaza Governorate]] are estimated to be as severe or worse. The [[OHCHR|Office for Human Rights]] states that the famine is the direct result of actions taken by the [[Israeli government]], while the Israeli government disputes the report and its methodology. [https://www.nytimes.com/2025/08/22/world/middleeast/famine-gaza-city-israel.html (''The New York Times'')] [https://www.ohchr.org/en/press-releases/2025/08/turk-says-gaza-governorate-famine-direct-result-israeli-government-actions (''OHCHR'')]
**[[Red Sea crisis]]
***A [[Houthi]] [[ballistic missile]] breaks up and a Houthi drone is intercepted over southern [[Israel]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/idf-downs-houthi-drone-over-southern-israel-after-several-failed-attempts/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Darfur campaign (2023–present)|Darfur campaign]]
***The [[Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights]] reports paramilitary attacks in [[Darfur]], [[Sudan]], left 89 civilians dead in 10 days. [https://apnews.com/article/sudan-far-ataques-milicias-guerra-9ee980b4c55a4cd8111c16c0f4a3c680 (AP)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**A naval drone operated by [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[Main Directorate of Intelligence (Ukraine)|military intelligence]] explodes in [[Novorossiysk]], [[Krasnodar Krai]], [[Russia]] after being seized by [[Russian commando frogmen|Russian military divers]], killing five of them. [https://www.msn.com/en-ca/news/world/ukrainian-naval-drone-explosion-in-novorossiysk-bay-kills-5-elite-russian-divers-intelligence-claims/ar-AA1L0L8X?ocid=winp1taskbar&cvid=82a1facb13f34181faf6ae93f242cbef&ei=8 (MSN)]
**Three militants who were involved in the [[Bucha massacre]] in 2022 are killed and two others are injured in an explosion at a house in [[Kalynove]], [[Luhansk Oblast]], Ukraine. [https://www.msn.com/en-ca/news/world/explosion-in-luhansk-region-eliminates-russian-militants-involved-in-bucha-atrocities/ar-AA1L5smR?ocid=winp1taskbar&cvid=3c16e386452c4361e9a414f4b543910e&ei=29 (MSN)]
*[[Sistan and Baluchestan insurgency]]
**Five police officers are killed in a [[mass shooting]] by unknown gunmen while patrolling on a highway in [[Sistan and Baluchestan province]], [[Iran]]. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-policia-tiroteo-sistan-baluchistan-pistoleros-cb687876d9bd8968f18a429d084878a2 (AP)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**Three people are killed, including both attackers, in an [[Islamic State]] [[suicide bombing]] and shooting at a checkpoint in [[Deir ez-Zor]], [[Syria]]. [https://shafaq.com/en/Middle-East/ISIS-suicide-attack-targets-checkpoint-in-Syria-s-Deir-ez-Zor (Shafaq News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Pembroke bus crash]]
**Five people are killed and 49 others are injured, including several airlifted, when a tour bus loses control and overturns on [[Interstate 90 in New York|Interstate 90 West]] in [[Pembroke, New York|Pembroke]], [[New York (state)|New York]], [[United States]]. [https://www.wivb.com/news/local-news/western-new-york/genesee-county/all-lanes-closed-after-bus-crash-on-i-90-in-pembroke/ (WIVB-TV)] [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/08/tour-bus-from-niagara-falls-overturns-in-new-york-4-dead-dozens-hurt/ (BNO News)]
*A part of the under-construction [[Jianzha Yellow River Bridge]] collapses into the [[Yellow River]] on the border of [[Jainca County]], [[Qinghai]], [[China]], killing twelve people and leaving four others missing. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/china-bridge-collapse-yellow-river-video-state-media-say-6-deaths/ (CBS News)]
*At least four people are killed and four others are injured in an explosion at a fireworks warehouse in San Miguel Zacaola, [[Santo Tomás Hueyotlipan]], [[Mexico]]. [https://municipiospuebla.mx/nota/2025-08-22/hueyotlipan/cuatro-muertos-deja-explosi%C3%B3n-de-polvor%C3%ADn-en-san-miguel-zacaola-sedena (''Municipios Puebla'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Corruption in Sri Lanka]]
**[[Sri Lanka police]] arrest and detain former [[President of Sri Lanka|president]] [[Ranil Wickremesinghe]] for allegedly [[political corruption|misusing public funds]] while in office. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/sri-lankas-former-president-wickremesinghe-remanded-over-alleged-misuse-state-2025-08-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Deportation of Kilmar Abrego Garcia]]
**Improperly deported [[El Salvador|Salvadoran]] national Kilmar Abrego Garcia is released from jail in [[Cookeville, Tennessee|Cookeville]], [[Tennessee]], United States, to reunite with family while awaiting trial on [[people smuggling]] charges. [https://apnews.com/article/abrego-garcia-jail-release-deportation-trial-6eb8e95da3bfb7b7ed89dc156702b295 (AP)]
*[[Killing of Iryna Zarutska]]
**[[Ukrainian refugee]] Iryna Zarutska is killed in a stabbing incident on the [[Lynx Blue Line]] in [[Charlotte, North Carolina]]. The suspect, identified as 34-year-old Decarlos Brown, is arrested. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/ukrainian-woman-stabbed-death-train-attack/story?id=125360100 (ABC News)] [https://www.wcnc.com/article/news/crime/deadly-stabbing-charlotte-nc-8-22-2025/275-01918405-4783-40c8-963f-0a6dd86c70c6 (CNBC)]
*At least five people are killed and 18 others are injured during clashes in [[Sulaymaniyah]], [[Kurdistan Region]], [[Iraq]], after the arrest of the nephew of former [[President of Iraq|president]] [[Jalal Talabani]]. [https://apnews.com/article/irak-politico-kurdo-detenido-enfrentamientos-065433c8fcf6298c9a417668820c8d49 (AP)]
*Five people are injured, including three in life-threatening condition, in an [[arson]] attack at an [[India]]n restaurant in [[Ilford]], [[Greater London]], [[England]]. No arrests have been made. [https://news.sky.com/story/three-people-in-a-life-threatening-condition-after-arson-attack-at-restaurant-13416616 (Sky News)]
*[[United States federal judge|United States district judge]] [[Christine Arguello]] of [[United States District Court for the District of Colorado|Colorado]] sentences former [[Gambia]]n [[paramilitary]] member Michael Sang Correa to 67.5 years in [[Incarceration in the United States|prison]] after a [[Juries in the United States|jury]] found him guilty of [[Torture in the United States|torture]] and conspiracy to commit torture related to abuses committed in 2006 as part of ex-[[President of the Gambia|president]] [[Yahya Jammeh]]'s death squad. The case marks the first successful U.S. federal conviction for torture under its [[extraterritorial jurisdiction]]. [https://trialinternational.org/latest-post/former-jungler-sentenced-to-over-67-years-for-torture/ (TRIAL International)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Schoof cabinet]]
**[[Netherlands|Dutch]] [[Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Netherlands|foreign minister]] [[Caspar Veldkamp]] resigns from the current [[Cabinet of the Netherlands|cabinet]] after failing to come to an agreement with coalition partners [[People's Party for Freedom and Democracy]] and [[Farmer–Citizen Movement]] over implementing additional sanctions against [[Israel]]. [https://www.dutchnews.nl/2025/08/no-extra-measures-against-israel-dutch-foreign-minister-resigns/ (DutchNews.nl)]
